messages:
marie: Quick sync 1: proposing a floating compact control for the playground when streaming. Elements: single Stop, compact token indicator, prompt-lib quick-insert. Prototype: https://redwood.design/mini-toolbar-new

ash: Desktop-first placement? We need rules for composer suggestions overlap.

marie: Desktop v1. Bottom-right above composer. Collapse to single icon on narrow widths. If suggestions open, nudge left or float above.

sam: Dev note: update token count at ~250ms debounce to avoid reflow. Use transforms for visual updates. Stop sends cancel; regen should be a separate action.

ash: UX: primary action = "Stop" (keeps partial). Put "Regenerate" in overflow to avoid accidental hits.

ben: Show "+N tokens" on prompt-lib hover/focus to surface cost. Also add keyboard tooltip.

kai: A11y: streaming region -> aria-live="polite"; token meter -> aria-label="token usage: 120 tokens"; toolbar in tab order. Ensure color not sole signal.

a11y-bot: Run keyboard-only flow, VoiceOver/NVDA test, verify contrast and reduced-motion support.

marie: Microcopy: Stop tooltip "Stop 1 keep partial"; Regenerate tooltip "Regenerate 1 restart". Keep concise.

sam: Regenerate will replace by default with toast "Response replaced 1 Undo" to simplify state.

ben: Token meter modes: collapsed (dot+num), compact (bar+num), expanded (sparkline). Default compact.

kai: Keyboard: Esc stops stream and returns focus to composer; confirm no shortcut conflicts. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

marie: Action items: ash to update comps (3 density modes); sam to prototype debounce + Esc handling; ben to write insert token microcopy + toast; kai to run quick a11y pass. We'll review in design sync. :sparkles:
